annotation.title_clean: 49 CFR Part 830—Notification and Reporting of Aircraft Accidents or Incidents and Overdue Aircraft, and Preservation of Aircraft Wreckage, Mail, Cargo, and Records
annotation.title_en: 49 CFR Part 830—Notification and Reporting of Aircraft Accidents or Incidents and Overdue Aircraft, and Preservation of Aircraft Wreckage, Mail, Cargo, and Records
annotation.summary_en: US NTSB regulation requiring operators to notify the NTSB of aircraft accidents, serious incidents and overdue aircraft, to file reports, and to preserve wreckage and records. Its definitions include unmanned aircraft accidents, so drone operators are covered.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators must immediately notify the NTSB of accidents and listed serious incidents.
Defines 'unmanned aircraft accident' (death or serious injury, or substantial damage to an aircraft with an airworthiness certificate).
Operators must file Form 6120 within 10 days of an accident.
Wreckage, cargo and records must be preserved and not disturbed until the NTSB takes custody.
Applies to US civil aircraft, certain public aircraft and foreign aircraft in the US.
